ws_stage_rules.title: Stage Rules
values: Only open opportunities qualify. Closed Won, Closed Lost, and On Hold are excluded.
Opportunities below $50,000 are not eligible for stage advancement.
When multiple deals qualify, advance the one at the most advanced stage. Stage order: Prospecting < Qualification < Proposal < Negotiation.
Priority flags in descriptions are for internal tracking only and do not affect stage progression eligibility.
Opportunities with 'Legal Hold' in their description are excluded from advancement regardless of stage or amount.
On the selected opportunity, record the selection rule ID, previous stage, and deal amount in an audit note.

fields.name: Aurora Tech - New Product
fields.description: Priority deal - CEO requested fast-track to Negotiation. Highest revenue potential.

fields.name: Aurora Tech - Professional Services
fields.description: Legal Hold - advancement paused pending contract review by Legal team. Do not advance until cleared.
